This small plot of beans is just a corner of my land — only a small piece next to my bigger fields. Beans do not need much fertilizer like maize does; they make their own strength in the soil, and my father taught me the same. I will put a little manure from my cattle because I have it at home, and I will keep my own seed from last year's harvest since it did well enough. For such a small plot, my wife and I can handle the weeding and harvesting ourselves without paying anyone.
